cards.name: Gut, Fanatical Priestess
cards.oracleText:
Specialize {5}
When Gut, Fanatical Priestess enters, up to one target creature you control fights target creature you don't control. If the creature you don't control would die this turn, exile it instead.

cards.name: Gut, Furious Fanatic
cards.oracleText: When this creature specializes, create a token that's a copy of a creature card exiled with this creature, except it has double strike and haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of your next end step.
